title: Cipher extends Barber Lake data center lease commitments to 20 years
source_used: Simply Wall St article carried by Yahoo Finance (9 Oct 2026)
key_facts: Cipher Digital has doubled the lease term for its Barber Lake data center to 20 years, lifting total contracted revenue above US$9 billion.
The revised agreement includes an additional 10-year commitment from an AI lab, tied to Fluidstack's existing lease.
That follow-on contract is expected to add about US$5.2 billion of contracted revenue for Cipher Digital over two decades.
Cipher Digital has shifted from adding bitcoin hash rate to delivering hyperscale AI and high-performance computing campuses such as Barber Lake, Black Pearl and Stingray.
Heavy project debt and grid approval uncertainty in Texas could slow campus energization and rent commencements.
quote_evidence: Cipher Digital (CIFR) has secured a much longer future for its Barber Lake data center by doubling the lease term to 20 years and lifting total contracted revenue above US$9b.
